description: Loan ad quoting rates and a payment, with APR labelled and a representative example.
content:
Pay off your cards with one ClearPath Personal Loan.

Rates start at 8.99% APR and go up to 35.99% APR, based on your credit profile. Loan amounts from $2,000 to $50,000, terms from 24 to 60 months.

Representative example: a $15,000 loan over 48 months at 10.99% APR has a monthly payment of $387.61 and a total repayment of $18,605.28. Example assumes no origination fee; fees of 0% to 8% may apply.

Checking your rate uses a soft credit pull and will not affect your credit score. Terms apply.
notes: Mentions a rate, a monthly payment and a term (all Reg Z triggering terms) but pairs them with the labelled APR and repayment terms, and stays inside the product facts (8.99%-35.99%, $2,000-$50,000, 24-60 months).
